title: Operator backdrop is solid
why: Critic on 63: the words of the board page showed through the 97 percent backdrop of the operator card as ghost text. The backdrop is solid.
now: The operator card sits on a clean dark backdrop.

edits.anchor: background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-void) 97%,transparent)';   // the attract is hidden behind the card
edits.replacement: background:var(--ui-void)';   /* v30.xx (cw-partyopbd) critic 63: the words of the board page showed through the 97 percent backdrop as ghost text. Solid now; the attract is hidden behind the card */
